sentences.en: An apparently small event may lead to a great result.
sentences.zh: 一个小事件可能会带来巨大的结果。

sentences.en: A gift of cheesecake is apparently good to soothe discord.
sentences.zh: 一块芝士蛋糕似乎是个平息纷争的好礼物。

sentences.en: Apparently "the iPhone sounds the death knell for the Internet."
sentences.zh: 看来，iPhone 的出现预示着互联网的终结。
